title: Phase 0 fixture: a deny check that forgets one case, fixed, and a mutant of the fix
summary: Not an example and never placed in examples/: the local, constructed fixture every example-targets stream's unit checks run on (llm-dlc/loops/example-targets.md, Phase 0). It is marked real-world only because the target route takes a real-world example; its sidecar's role is control and its revisions are fixture sources, never upstream commits.
